aggregation: Source record nTPM retains the maximum of mapped values. Regional ranking uses an equal-area arithmetic mean of mapped source-entry means, not a sample- or donor-weighted estimate.
laterality: The downloaded tables do not provide hemisphere-specific regional values. The same evidence is shown on left and right parcels.
spatialMethod: Curated anatomical name correspondence, not spatial registration or pointwise gene localization.

caudalanteriorcingulate.rationale: Supragenual anterior cingulate samples provide related regional evidence; they do not establish the exact DKT caudal-anterior boundary.

rostralanteriorcingulate.rationale: Pregenual/subgenual anterior cingulate samples overlap the broader rostral-anterior territory; sampling boundaries differ from DKT.

caudalmiddlefrontal.rationale: Dorsolateral prefrontal cortex is broader than this DKT middle-frontal subdivision. No separate caudal/rostral measurement is claimed.

rostralmiddlefrontal.rationale: Dorsolateral prefrontal cortex is broader than this DKT middle-frontal subdivision. No separate caudal/rostral measurement is claimed.

cuneus.rationale: Only broader occipital-cortex evidence is used. These data do not resolve this individual DKT occipital parcel.

lateraloccipital.rationale: Only broader occipital-cortex evidence is used. These data do not resolve this individual DKT occipital parcel.

pericalcarine.rationale: Area striata (primary visual cortex) is anatomically related to calcarine cortex, but its cytoarchitectonic boundary is not the DKT pericalcarine boundary.
